pending_qa.q: How should a homeowner decide between continuing to market a house for sale versus converting it to a rental property or Airbnb?
pending_qa.r: The decision depends on whether the property aligns with your debt elimination goals. If the house payment represents one-third of your salary and you have outstanding debt, selling it frees up that capital for debt payoff. If it will not sell at market price, renting it could generate income, but only if it cash-flows positively after all expenses—the transcript shows Rod has had his house on the market since January with no offers, suggesting either overpricing or market conditions that may make rental a viable alternative.
